## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.5
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.109.5

4 PRs. 1 fixed, 1 improved. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Deployment:** Fixed the standalone UI image shipping outdated nginx and zlib, now nginx 1.31.10 and zlib 1.4 (#54149)
- **Performance:** Improved end-user restriction refreshes to read only restricted customers instead of the whole end-user table (#51772) <sup>Also in [1.108.17](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.17), [1.110.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.4), [1.111.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.111.0)</sup>

---

Backport #54292 · [Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.109.4...v1.109.5)

## Verify Docker Image Signature

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.111.0
```

releases.body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.4
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.110.4

4 PRs. 1 fixed, 1 improved. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Deployment:** Fixed the standalone UI image shipping outdated nginx and zlib, now nginx 1.31.10 and zlib 1.4 (#54150)

Azure (2) - Fixed `azure_ai` calls that authenticate with only an Entra token failing with 400 from Foundry (#49769) - Fixed `azure_ai` chat and `/v1/messages` on Foundry project, resource and `/openai/v1` bases failing with 4xx errors (#51144, #53408)

Vertex AI and Gemini (12) - Added `gemini-decision-1` on `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone` (#53696) - Fixed Gemini image chat returning the thought draft image next to the final one in `message.images` (#50709) - Fixed Gemini dropping `const` from tool and response schemas, so const fields came back empty or made up (#53415) - Fixed Gemini and Vertex AI silently dropping `video_url` content parts (#53420) - Fixed Vertex Gemini answering 400 to every `service_tier` value (#53428) - Fixed Gemini 3+ dropping web search when function tools are also sent (#53432) - Fixed Vertex image edits drawing a new picture every turn and failing with 400 on the third image turn (#53446) - Fixed Gemini image generation and edits ignoring `size`, `aspect_ratio`, `image_size` and `imageConfig` (#53581) - Fixed Anthropic SDK 2.x calls to Claude on Vertex AI `/v1/messages` failing with 400 over `anthropic-version` (#53590) - Fixed Gemini prompt caching never hitting when a conversation carries later system messages (#53635) - Fixed Gemini batch embeddings billing video and other media inputs at $0 or at the text rate (#53679) - Fixed `n` above 1 with image `modalities` on Vertex image models failing with an unclear error, now a clear 400 (#53752)
Other providers (6) - Added Gradium text-to-speech on `/v1/audio/speech` (#53463) - Added the Perplexity Orchestrator provider (`perplexity_orchestrator/`) with cost tracking (#53585) - Added Gnani transcription with Prisma v2.5 and v3 on `/v1/audio/transcriptions` (#53672) - Fixed Mistral on Vertex AI and Bedrock answering 400 to tool call ids in the conversation history (#53426) - Fixed a `TypeError` when SAP streams `reasoning_content` as a list of signed blocks (#53458) - Fixed empty or cut SageMaker and Bedrock agent streams returning 200, now a 502 so retries and fallbacks run (#53482)

Responses API (2) - Fixed Codex over `ws /v1/responses` failing after its first tool call on Bedrock, Azure AI and OpenRouter (#53410) - Fixed faked `/v1/responses` streams returning reasoning items that later fail with 400 `invalid_encrypted_content` (#53747)

MCP (2) - Fixed a forced hosted MCP `tool_choice` failing under `drop_params`, and Bedrock batch rows ignoring `drop_params` (#53697) - Changed gateway-owned DCR client registration to opt-in, fixing `403 oauth_principal_mismatch` for shared service keys (#53059) Also in [1.109.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.4), [1.110.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.3)
Guardrails (1) - Fixed `/v1/messages` guardrails dropping `cache_control` on Claude and Gemini aliases, which lost prompt caching (#53832)

Other (1) - Fixed decision calls failing with `use_litellm_proxy` or a `litellm_proxy/` model, and Router sending them to OpenAI (#53196)

> [!TIP]
> The `lts` image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts` to stay on the newest LTS patch

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.15
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.108.15 (LTS)

9 PRs. 1 added, 2 fixed. 1 needs action

### Action required

- **Other providers:** Set `api_key` or the provider's key env var on keyless JSON-configured deployments, which now get a 401 (#50819)

### Changes

- **Other providers:** Added the ResetData provider and fixed $0 spend on Groq and Meta transcription (#50819)
- **Other providers:** Fixed Cohere v2 streamed tool calls arriving as one empty chunk (#47794)
- **Other providers:** Fixed Cohere v2 chat ignoring `tool_choice` and returning 400 for `reasoning_effort` and `json_schema` `response_format` (#50834)

## What's new in 1.111.0-rc.3

15 PRs. 11 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Anthropic:** Fixed `temperature=1` returning 400 on Claude models that removed sampling params on Anthropic, Vertex AI and Azure AI, broken since v1.110.0-rc.2 (#52341) <sup>Also in [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>
- **Responses API:** Fixed streams retrying after output reached the client, which sent duplicate events and billed extra calls (#52461) <sup>Also in [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>
- **Responses API:** Fixed streams that fail after reasoning output restarting on a fallback group and sending a second response (#52616) <sup>Also in [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>
- **Caching:** Fixed GPT-6.2 system prompts missing the prompt cache on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/messages` unless `store: false` (#52906) <sup>Also in [1.106.12](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.12), [1.108.13](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.13), [1.109.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.3), [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>
- **Cost tracking and pricing:** Fixed forwarded Anthropic credentials on `/v1/messages` ignoring the deployment's custom prices, broken since v1.109.0 (#52313) <sup>Also in [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed 503s on a burst of first requests for new customer org aliases, which left their spend untracked (#52080)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed JWT key mappings without `jwt_issuer` taking 5 minutes to apply when `litellm_jwtauth.issuers` is set, broken since v1.103.0 (#52350) <sup>Also in [1.108.13](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.13), [1.109.3](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.3), [1.110.2](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.2)</sup>

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.111.0-rc.2
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.111.0-rc.2

1 PRs. 1 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **OpenAI:** Fixed GPT-6.2 prompt caching for system prompts sent to `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/messages` with `store: false` (#52657)

---

[Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.111.0-rc.1...v1.111.0-rc.2)

## What's new in 1.109.2

30 PRs. 1 added, 14 fixed, 3 changed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **OpenAI:** Fixed GPT-6.2 prompt caching for system prompts sent to `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/messages` with `store: false` (#52664, #52707)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Added Gemini batches on `/v1/batches`, with output download through `/v1/files` and spend tracking (#51032)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed Gemini batches created through `/gemini` logging $0 spend with model `unknown` (#51279)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed `reasoning_effort: "xhigh"` returning 400 on `gemini-4-hydrogen`, and added its pricing (#52060)
- **Other providers:** Fixed Perplexity billing cached prompt tokens at the full input rate when the response has no `usage.cost` (#51669)
- **Other providers:** Fixed the `/fal_ai` pass-through price check missing submits sent with `/requests/..` or an encoded `?` in the path (#51671)
- **Embeddings, images and audio:** Fixed custom image handlers not receiving `n`, `size`, `quality`, `response_format`, `user` or `mask` (#52051)
- **Batches and files:** Fixed file ownership checks not matching other spellings of the same provider file id, like `files%2F<id>` (#51498)
- **Routing and fallbacks:** Fixed streamed `/v1/responses` calls that fail before any output skipping the same model group retry (#51953, #52561)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed out-of-memory restarts when blocked or over-limit keys retry large requests, now refused before the body is read (#51428, #51525, #51675, #52310)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed budgets with long unit spellings like `1month`, `7days` or `2weeks` resetting every midnight (#51672)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Fixed team member spend never resetting for users auto-joined to a default team or given `default_team_member_models`, broken since v1.95.0 (#51728, #51960)
- **Admin UI:** Fixed usage pages returning 500 when a database lookup for key, user or team details fails (#50253) <sup>Also in [1.110.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.0)</sup>
- **Admin UI:** Fixed the Spend Per User card on User Usage showing no users (#51044)
- **Admin UI:** Fixed Login with SSO redirecting to `http://` behind TLS termination, broken since v1.108.0 (#52213)
- **Deployment:** Changed filelock, oauthlib, opentelemetry, dnspython, tornado, next, soupsieve and msal-node to newer releases (#51712, #52322, #52420)
- **Deployment:** Changed the UI image to slim nginx, which drops `curl` but keeps `wget` and `nc` (#52298)
- **Other:** Changed `/health` errors to drop Python stack traces, which stay in the proxy log with `--detailed_debug` (#52005) <sup>Also in [1.110.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.110.0)</sup>

## Verify Docker Image Signature

```bash
cosign verify \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0
```

## What's new in 1.108.11 (LTS)

22 PRs. 1 added, 14 fixed, 2 changed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Azure:** Fixed 400 when sending `reasoning_effort` to DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro on `azure_ai` (#52070)
- **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed `guarded_text` parts in system and assistant messages being dropped instead of checked by the guardrail (#51776)
- **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed aborted Invoke streams on `/v1/messages` that kept generating billed output tokens upstream (#52210)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed 500 when the chat history has an earlier tool call with null or truncated arguments (#50020)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed 400 when sending `reasoning_effort: "xhigh"` to `gemini-4-hydrogen` (#52060)
- **Other providers:** Fixed Cohere embeddings ignoring `COHERE_API_BASE` and always calling api.cohere.ai (#52194)
- **Other providers:** Fixed OpenRouter streams sending an empty choice after `finish_reason: stop` that broke strict clients (#52200)
- **Chat completions:** Fixed LiteLLM's own MCP and `fake_stream` params reaching provider request bodies and causing 400s (#52225)
- **Responses API:** Fixed 500 on `/v1/responses` when `allowed_openai_params` is a string or tuple (#52203)
- **Messages API:** Fixed streamed thinking blocks ending without `signature_delta`, so clients dropped them on the next tool step (#52117)
- **Embeddings, images and audio:** Fixed custom image handlers not receiving `n`, `size`, `quality` and the other OpenAI image params (#52051)
- **Keys, teams and auth:** Changed team model writes so only proxy admins can set `os.environ/` values, team admins now get 403 (#51874)
- **Admin UI:** Fixed SSO login detouring through `/sso/key/generate/` and redirecting to `http://` behind TLS termination, broken since v1.108.0 (#52213)
- **Deployment:** Changed the UI image to slim nginx, which drops `curl` but keeps `wget` and `nc` (#52298)
- **SDK:** Fixed valid Messages and OCR requests with dict-subclass inputs failing when `LITELLM_RUST=true` (#51812)
- **Performance:** Fixed proxy pods running out of memory when clients retry 429s with large request bodies (#51428)
- **Other:** Added native `generateContent` support for custom providers registered in `custom_provider_map` (#51083)

Earlier releases still verify with the key. ## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \ --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.111.0-dev.4 ``` Same command for `docker.io/litellm/litellm` and the Helm chart at `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm/chart/litellm:1.111.0-dev.4` ## What's new in 1.111.0-dev.4 138 PRs. 18 added, 69 fixed, 11 changed, 3 improved, 1 removed. 2 need action ### Action required - **Logging and observability:** Set `general_settings.redact_tokens_in_spend_logs: true` to keep token scanning in spend logs (#51729) - **AWS Bedrock:** Remove unsupported `service_tier` values from Bedrock requests (#50516) ### Highlights - **Admin UI:** Added customer organization, team and member management in Customer Management (#51521, #51661, #51713) - **Vector stores:** Added OpenSearch vector store `filters` support and hybrid keyword plus vector search (#51131) - **Keys, teams and auth:** Added `budget_limits` windows on internal users (#51763) - **Keys, teams and auth:** Added email warnings to key owners before opted-in virtual keys expire (#51482) - **SDK:** Fixed hang and `RecursionError` on every completion call when `litellm.model_fallbacks` is set (#51817) - **Deployment:** Fixed proxy boot failure on PostgreSQL 12 without pgcrypto, broken since v1.110.0-rc.1 (#51868) - **Performance:** Improved streaming latency by closing streams right after the last event (#51487) - **Responses API:** Fixed Responses fallback replaying tool calls that were already delivered (#51683) - **Azure:** Fixed 400 on `azure/` Responses and chat calls to Foundry project `/openai/v1` bases (#51767) ### All changes

AWS Bedrock (5) - Fixed 500 on Bedrock Converse requests with `s3://` image, document or video URLs (#50577) - Fixed aborted Bedrock Invoke `/v1/messages` streams still reading from Bedrock (#50657) - Fixed Bedrock vector store search 400 on OpenAI-shape `filters` and ignored `drop_params` (#51291) - Fixed Titan embedding calls on Bedrock `/invoke` passthrough not being billed or logged (#51701) - Changed Bedrock to return 400 for unsupported `service_tier` values and to forward `reserved` (#50516)
Vertex AI and Gemini (9) - Added key, team, org and project labels on Vertex AI requests (#50732) - Fixed wrong default `max_tokens` for versioned Claude ids on Vertex AI (#40376) - Fixed shutdown dates on Gemini TTS and Live preview models to match Google's deprecations page (#51657) - Fixed PDF embeddings on `gemini-embedding-2` reporting 0 tokens and $0 cost (#51673) - Fixed `document_ocr`, `audio_track_extraction` and `auto_truncate` being dropped on Gemini embeddings (#51686) - Fixed streamed Gemini TTS on chat completions returning no audio in `delta.audio` (#51750) - Fixed Vertex 400 for tools with a top-level `anyOf`, `oneOf` or `allOf` schema (#51835) - Improved Vertex RAG Engine vector store searches by reusing one Google token (#51239) - Removed Flex prices from three Vertex AI Gemini 4 rows (#51735)
Other providers (13) - Added Vercel AI Gateway models for Decisions requests with cost tracking (#50642) - Added GitHub App authentication with PEM upload for GitHub Copilot (#51427) - Added fal.ai Pixverse video billing by clip duration and resolution, billed at $0 before (#51679) - Added `github_copilot/gemini-4-hydrogen` to the model cost map (#51696) - Added the 4K output price for `runwayml/seedance2_5`, billed at the 720p rate before (#51697) - Fixed OpenRouter streams emitting an empty choice after `finish_reason: stop` (#50210) - Fixed Cohere embeddings ignoring `COHERE_API_BASE` (#50249) - Fixed Hugging Face chat ignoring `HUGGINGFACE_API_BASE` and crashing with env endpoints and `huggingface/tgi` (#51449) - Fixed `low` and `medium` reasoning effort being sent as `high` for `mistral/mistral-large-4` (#51693) - Fixed 500 when streaming `opencode_go` Messages-protocol models through chat completions (#51715) - Fixed `together_ai/*` listing retired Together models that answer 400 (#51827) - Changed OpenRouter failed non-streaming completions to raise instead of returning success (#50880) - Changed Mistral Magistral to receive native reasoning levels instead of prompt instructions (#51329)
Chat completions (1) - Fixed 500 on gateway chat completions when Claude returns a thinking block (#51774)
Responses API (2) - Fixed Responses fallback replaying tool calls that were already delivered (#51683) - Fixed 500 when `allowed_openai_params` is a string or tuple on Responses models, broken since v1.109.0-rc.1 (#51751)
Messages API (2) - Fixed synchronous iteration of streamed `/v1/messages` calls routed to OpenAI or Azure (#51305) - Fixed gateway ignoring a deployment's `thinking`, `system` and `tools` params on Messages requests (#51834)
Batches and files (2) - Added per-model enqueued token limits for batches on projects (#51608) - Fixed 404 retrieving or deleting a managed file when the request also names a model (#51780)
Vector stores (1) - Added OpenSearch vector store `filters` support and hybrid keyword plus vector search (#51131)
Token counting (4) - Added native upstream token counting for Mistral (#50653) - Fixed token counts ignoring `thinking`, reasoning effort and `tool_choice` (#51079) - Fixed local token counts ignoring the request's `tool_choice` on the count routes (#51133) - Changed `/v1/messages/count_tokens` to answer 400 instead of 500 for messages missing `role` or `content` (#51284)
MCP (2) - Fixed MCP gateway sign-in ignoring the servers selected on the connect page (#50973) - Fixed `resources/read` failing on the aggregate `/mcp` endpoint with two or more servers (#51462)
Guardrails (1) - Changed Straiker blocked prompts to return 200 with the block message instead of 400 (#51401)
Caching (2) - Fixed in-memory cache keeping expired keys and panicking on very long TTLs (#51388) - Fixed `cache_control` being dropped on tool plus reasoning chat requests sent over Responses (#51783)
Routing and fallbacks (4) - Fixed Complexity Router dropping `temperature` and output-token limits from routed prompts (#51702) - Fixed `/model_group/info` missing key aliases and team model aliases (#51754) - Fixed wildcard aliases over unknown orgs listing every catalog model id (#51805) - Changed over-`tpm` requests to fail at once with an error naming the request size (#51838)
Cost tracking and pricing (3) - Added cost map rows for Soniox v6 and four DeepInfra models, and corrected retirement dates (#51620) - Added `fal_ai` Seedream v5 Pro US text-to-image and edit pricing (#51881) - Fixed cost maps with a byte order mark failing to load and `register_model(url)` calling out in offline mode (#51545)

Keys, teams and auth (18) - Added email warnings to key owners before opted-in virtual keys expire (#51482) - Added `budget_limits` windows on internal users (#51763) - Fixed carried end-user spend being lost when a budget reset is retried (#51143) - Fixed `401 Expired Key` in Claude Code after a `lite login --pkce --config-claude` key expires, broken since v1.102.0 (#51319) - Fixed customer org provisioning retries failing and duplicate org aliases breaking requests (#51607) - Fixed customer budget alerts not firing for members and ignoring team budget overrides (#51645) - Fixed budget updates failing for customer teams and stale member caches after inherited budget changes (#51654) - Fixed first request for a new customer org dropping its member, so member spend was never tracked (#51660) - Fixed dashboard sessions ignoring team models, which made Aria show `No available models` (#51663) - Fixed `budget_override_expires_at` being stored on customer rows with no `budget_override` (#51667) - Fixed budgets set as `12months` or `1month` resetting every midnight instead of on the calendar schedule (#51672) - Fixed a key pinned to one customer org registering a different org alias before its 403 (#51674) - Fixed `/customer/new` budgets resetting on a different schedule than other budget endpoints (#51689) - Fixed `ExceededBudget` persisting after a customer budget reset (#51694) - Fixed 403 for existing customer members on retry or alias update at the free tier team limit (#51698) - Fixed leftover budget rows when deleting a customer team that only had `budget_override` (#51703) - Fixed `/queue/chat/completions` skipping budget checks and `request_tag_mappings` (#51753) - Fixed SCIM PATCH or PUT 404 on a group with no team so user deactivation applies, broken since v1.99.0 (#51829)
Admin UI (7) - Added customer organization, team and member management in Customer Management (#51521, #51661, #51713) - Added an admin setting to turn Aria on or off for internal users (#51641) - Added free tier limit of 5 customer organizations, teams and members without an Enterprise license (#51687) - Fixed customer budget displays showing `No cap` for monthly and yearly budgets (#51658) - Fixed customer org settings tab rendering in a narrow left column (#51700) - Changed customer usage page to show member spend above top models (#51677) - Changed Customer Portal to Customer Management in the UI and API error titles (#51891)
Deployment (4) - Fixed Helm Ingress sending 16 gateway-only paths to backend pods instead of the gateway (#50760) - Fixed Docker image reporting a stale `litellm-proxy` package version, broken since v1.110.0-dev.2 (#51807) - Fixed proxy boot failure on PostgreSQL 12 without pgcrypto, broken since v1.110.0-rc.1 (#51868) - Changed the Docker base image to a Wolfi build with patched glibc (#51550)
SDK (2) - Fixed missing `/v1/messages` streaming callbacks on SDK installs without redis, broken since v1.98.0 (#51685) - Fixed hang and `RecursionError` on every completion call when `litellm.model_fallbacks` is set (#51817)
Performance (2) - Improved streaming latency by closing streams right after the last event (#51487) - Improved spend log token redaction speed for large prompts (#51770)
Other (3) - Added native `generateContent` serving for custom providers (#51083) - Fixed `cancel_on_disconnect` not applying to `/v1/rerank` (#51252) - Fixed `AttributeError` on parallel first requests to a fresh worker (#51591)

- `pip install "litellm[proxy]==1.111.0.dev3"` failed at first, because the `litellm-proxy-extras` and `litellm-enterprise` versions it pins were not on PyPI yet. They are published now, so the install works

The Docker image, Helm chart and PyPI wheels of this release are otherwise the same code as v1.111.0-dev.4. See [its notes](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.111.0-dev.4) for what changed

## Verify this release

This release candidate is built from [`a1a541b`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/a1a541bfb1295d44bcb3b9ab882ba8f8b1c2dfa5), the reviewed merge of #51771 into `rc/1.107.0`. It is published as `1.107.0rc4` on PyPI and `v1.107.0-rc.4` on Docker

After the Oct 21 incident (#47826) we replaced the cosign key that signs our Docker images. These images are signed with the new key from [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065)

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.107.0-rc.4
```

## Why a new 1.107 release candidate

Some users are still running the 1.107 release candidates and needed to link their GitHub Copilot per-user credentials without access to the Admin UI. This release brings the `lite credentials connect` command to that line. If you are not on a 1.107 release candidate, [1.109.1](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.1) is the current stable

## What's new in 1.107.0-rc.4

14 PRs. 3 added, 8 fixed, 1 changed. 1 needs action

### Action required

- **Responses API:** Set `drop_params: true` or stop sending Responses-only fields such as `max_tool_calls` to providers bridged through chat completions (#48655) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>

### Changes

- **Azure:** Added gpt-image edits on Azure AI Foundry deployments, including deployments under a custom name (#49650)
- **AWS Bedrock:** Added image search on Bedrock knowledge bases with `query_image`, including image hits in the results (#51062)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed Gemini image calls billing text, thinking and Vertex Priority tokens at the wrong rates (#51017)
- **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Fixed `/gemini` `batchGenerateContent` batches logging $0 with model `unknown` instead of billing the calling key (#51279)
- **Other providers:** Fixed `reasoning_effort` being dropped or rejected for Baseten models (#40152) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>
- **Other providers:** Fixed `baseten/*` listing retired deployment IDs instead of the current Baseten Model APIs (#46945) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>
- **Responses API:** Fixed missing or repeated `sequence_number` on bridged `/v1/responses` streaming events (#44944)
- **Responses API:** Fixed streamed MCP follow-ups keeping only the latest tool round, so models repeated tool calls (#47698) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>
- **Responses API:** Fixed 400 on Bedrock when a `previous_response_id` chain contains a failed turn (#48647) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>
- **Responses API:** Changed Responses-only fields such as `max_tool_calls` to answer 400 on bridged providers unless `drop_params` is on (#48655) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>
- **Batches and files:** Added Gemini batches on `/v1/batches`, with output download through `/v1/files` and spend tracking (#51032)
- **Routing and fallbacks:** Fixed Decisions calls on a mixed model group hitting a Bedrock deployment and answering 400 (#48175) <sup>Also in [1.109.0](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.109.0)</sup>

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.110.0-rc.1/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* fix(completion): accept a tool_choice that forces an OpenAI hosted tool by @kerry-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50578
* fix(accounting): stop delivery metrics from scanning retained receipts on every flush by @joshua-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50565
* fix(key/info): return 400 instead of 500 when no key is provided by @apex-mochen in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/43577
* fix(gemini): add the Flex above-200k cache read price to gemini-3.1-pro-preview rows by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50607
* test(observability): match the full card number instead of a 4111 substring that timestamps can contain by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50612
* fix(proxy): align ownership and scope handling by @mateo-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50600
* feat(proxy): total_timeout bounds a whole non-streaming request by @joshua-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50496
* fix(cli): end the local login when lite logout cannot check the OS keychain by @zoveki in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50098
* fix(ui): label every budget reset time in the Admin UI with UTC by @zoveki in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50591
* fix(proxy)!: price expanded wildcard /model/info rows as the model their calls route to by @paveln83 in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49128
* fix(bedrock): derive the web identity session policy per AWS caller by @tavren27 in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50592
* perf(router): skip unused deployment reads in the callback filter step and cache anthropic capability probes by @narmstrong-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50641
* test: update stale integration expectations and backport the Together e2e repin (#50601) by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50756
* test(integration): drop the empty-string n case from the Gemini long decode test by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50794
* test: update the spend tests that still expected the pre-ledger accounting queues by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50805
* fix(router): backport the mid-stream request fallback fix (#50260) to rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50798
* test: repair four integration tests on rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50855
* fix(redis): backport the per-request Redis batch scope leak fix (#50751) to rc/1.110.0 by @narmstrong-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50949
* fix(router): backport the registry lock fix (#50933) to rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50993

## New Contributors
* @apex-mochen made their first contribution in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/43577

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.110.0-dev.2...v1.110.0-rc.1

## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0 ``` Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images ## What's new in 1.109.0 982 PRs. 144 added, 424 fixed, 60 changed, 17 improved, 9 removed. 5 need action ### Action required - **Routing and fallbacks:** Change string fallback targets to lists of model names (#48943) - **Caching:** Switch `cache_params.type` from `disk` to `local` or `redis`, since the `disk` cache backend (diskcache) has been removed (#48114) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Add `optional_pre_call_checks: ["enforce_model_rate_limits"]` to keep a hard `rpm` cap on deployments (#48873) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Set `drop_params: true` or stop sending `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` to Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and newer (#47645) - **Deployment:** Deploy Lens from its own chart and set `lens.*` in your values (#49169) ### Highlights - **Admin UI:** Added a Chat UI with a model hub, image generation and usage metrics (#48108) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Added mid-stream fallback continuation so a streaming chat cut off mid-answer continues on the configured fallback (#41127) - **Deployment:** Added `LITELLM_OFFLINE_MODE` to turn off every fetch LiteLLM makes on its own with one switch (#48096) - **Cost tracking and pricing:** Added `model_info.pricing_provider` to price a deployment from another provider's catalog rates instead of $0 (#47620) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Added Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS support, including multi-speaker voices and `mp3`, `opus`, `alaw` and `mulaw` output (#31915) - **SDK:** Fixed tool calls on `completion()` and `responses()` failing with `No module named 'mcp'` on base SDK installs (#45961) Also in [1.108.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.4) ### All changes
OpenAI (19) - Added per-deployment workload identity on non-chat routes, realtime and the moderation guardrail (#39966) - Added the 12-hour cache write rate for `gpt-5.6-cyber` (#48246) - Added OpenAI `gpt-6.1-terra` with pricing (#48429) - Added Batch and Ultrafast 12-hour cache write rates for OpenAI models (#48433) - Added `gpt-6-rosalind` to the model cost map with its published prices (#49268) - Added `gpt-6-astra-law` with pricing from the OpenAI pricing page (#49444) - Fixed 400 errors and $0 spend logs on `gpt-transcribe` calls without `response_format` (#44021) - Fixed nonstreaming `aiohttp_openai` responses dropping `service_tier` (#47263) - Fixed `prompt_cache_retention` such as `24h` being silently dropped instead of sent upstream (#47480) - Fixed `/health` marking OpenAI and Azure audio chat models unhealthy (#47730) - Fixed OpenAI `context_length_exceeded` errors raising `BadRequestError` instead of `ContextWindowExceededError` (#47954) - Fixed 12-hour prompt cache writes on `openai/gpt-5.6` and newer billing at the 30-minute rate (#48088) - Fixed uncatalogued ChatGPT models hitting an unsupported Chat Completions endpoint (#48244) - Fixed the whole `reasoning_effort` dict not being sent when chat is bridged to Responses (#48807) - Fixed 400 `invalid_beta` on Agents API calls through the OpenAI passthrough (#49009) - Fixed empty `e.response.text` on OpenAI and Azure errors so the upstream error body is readable (#49079) - Changed OpenAI 401 and 404 `invalid_request_error` to raise matching exceptions, not `BadRequestError` (#32537) - Changed the ChatGPT session id to derive from `prompt_cache_key` for stable cache affinity (#42014) - Changed `gpt-6-luna` Decisions cache rates to the standard cached and write rates (#48066)
Azure (18) - Added Entra ID auth, including keyless auth, for Azure Decisions on `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone` (#46539, #48529) - Added access to Foundry agents through the project Responses API for `azure_ai/agents/` (#47717) - Added `azure_ai/MAI-Code-1.1-Flash` (#47779) - Added `max_input_tokens` of 32768 for `azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1` (#48434) - Added `outputContentFormat=markdown` support on `/ocr` for Azure Document Intelligence (#48926) - Fixed Foundry chat requests losing OpenAI prompt cache breakpoints (#45299) - Fixed `/v1/responses` 404 on dated `api_version` deployments and `azure_ai` Grok reasoning token billing (#46377) - Fixed under-billed Grok reasoning tokens on `azure_ai` when the deployment name lacks "grok" (#46969) - Fixed Azure realtime over WebRTC failing with a 404 on `client_secrets` and an invalid token on the SDP exchange (#47316) - Fixed 400 from Foundry when tool results contain `tool_reference` parts on chat (#48032) - Fixed 400 on `azure_ai/claude-*` when using `thinking.block_binding` (#48033) - Fixed Responses API calls that use an explicit v1 Azure base URL (#48118) - Fixed 404 on Azure vector store retrieve, update and delete (#48224) - Fixed null audio capability metadata on two Azure audio snapshot models (#48475) - Fixed Azure `context_length_exceeded` raising `BadRequestError` so `context_window_fallbacks` never ran (#48616) - Fixed batch calls on unversioned `azure/` o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini billing at the standard rate (#49182) - Changed `max_input_tokens` to 128000 for `gpt-chat-latest` on Azure (#48252) - Improved Entra auth by reusing credentials and tokens across requests and refreshing them off the event loop (#46421, #47348, #48769)

Fixed typed streaming text access breaking on `/v1/responses` when `logprobs` is omitted (#48686) - Fixed `moderation` on `/v1/responses` being dropped before the OpenAI call (#48708) - Fixed later citation batches and pending citations being dropped when streaming Responses (#48747) - Fixed `litellm.responses()` through `litellm_proxy/` leaving `e.body`, `e.code` and `e.type` empty on errors (#49073) - Fixed dict `reasoning_effort` losing `mode` and `context` on Azure, ChatGPT, Perplexity, xAI, Fireworks and Copilot (#49082) - releases.body:
> [!TIP]
> The `lts` image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts` to stay on the newest LTS patch

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.3
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.108.3 (LTS)

11 PRs. 3 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed every request failing on a Bedrock deployment with `api_base: ""`, which answered 500 or 400 (#50449)
- **MCP:** Fixed tool results over 1 MiB failing with `SSE stream ended without a response`, broken since v1.103.0 (#47034)
- **Guardrails:** Fixed model-level `post_call` guardrails checking each response twice and calling the moderation provider twice (#50463)

---

Backport #50484 · Backport #50487 · [Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.108.2...v1.108.3)
